forecasts.name: Climate Pessimist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Black Sea sunflower crops were withered by record summer temperatures. Thin crush margins and logistics risks will push sunoil over $1,844.

forecasts.name: Land-Grab Realist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Black Sea maritime attacks and drought in Romanian sunflower regions tighten available vegetable oil stocks, accelerating import substitution and spot spikes.

forecasts.name: Geopolitics Hawk · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Sunflower oil is concentrated in the Black Sea chokepoint. With shipping attacks surging and Kazakh trade bans, right-tail risk is high.

forecasts.name: BirdLife Europe, EEB, WWF and Greenpeace (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Drought in the Black Sea and Danube basin, compounded by logistics conflicts, increases the likelihood of sunflower oil surpassing $1,844.

forecasts.name: Copa-Cogeca (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Black Sea maritime conflict threatens crushing logistics and export flows, offering strong support for European oilseed and sunoil prices.

forecasts.name: IFPRI (Joseph Glauber) (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Severe Black Sea maritime attacks disrupt vegetable oil logistics, though Indian substitution toward palm oil dampens prolonged rallies past $1,844/mt.

forecasts.name: IMF (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Maritime attacks and shipping disruptions in the Black Sea threaten vegetable oil transit, lifting export parity despite palm oil substitution.

forecasts.name: Agronomist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Autumn crush suppresses oil values initially, but by March the post-harvest glut gives way to tighter stocks, opening a seasonal recovery toward $1,844.

forecasts.name: FAO (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Escalating Black Sea port tensions threaten sunflower seed crushing and oil logistics, though palm oil substitution limits aggressive rallies.

forecasts.name: European Commission DG AGRI (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Black Sea disruptions lend support, but buyer shifts toward cheaper palm and soy oils constrain sunflower oil rallies.

forecasts.name: Macro / Dollar · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Vegetable oils share the macro ag floor, but sunflower oil faces inter-crop competition, keeping $1,844 near market consensus.

forecasts.name: Crowd Follower · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Market trades at 34%. Sunflower oil pulled back sharply in September, so following the recent price action tilts my forecast slightly down.

forecasts.name: USDA WASDE (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Recent price softening and buyer substitution into cheaper palm and soy oils will restrain sunflower oil rallies above $1,844/mt.

forecasts.name: Scott Irwin (farmdoc) (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Cheaper palm oil substitution is actively dampening vegetable oil demand. Supply shifts make a sustained surge above $1,844 improbable.

forecasts.name: Efficient-Market Skeptic · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Sunflower oil has already corrected from $1,800 to $1,677. Black Sea headlines are fully digested, and palm oil substitution caps upside below $1,844.

forecasts.name: Adaptation Optimist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Buyer substitution to palm and soy oil relieves pressure on sunoil, curbing price spikes as oilseed processors adapt.
